activities.topic: Real and Digital Interaction in Mixed Reality

activity_1.title: Observe Real Interaction
steps: Choose two objects from your home.
Interact with the objects by making them touch or move.
Observe how one object reacts when it touches another.
Think about why the objects behave in that way.
Relate this interaction to real-world physical behavior.
examples: Bouncing a ball on the floor
Tapping a spoon on a cup
Rolling a pencil on a table
Dropping a stone on the ground

activity_2.title: Imagine a Virtual Object Reacting
steps: Think about a digital object interacting with your real action.
Imagine how the digital object would react to your movement.
Write one or two sentences describing your idea.
Relate your idea to real-world interactions.
Think about how technology can make this possible.
examples: Hitting a digital ball with a real stick
Pushing a digital car with your hand
Stopping a digital robot using a real book
Moving a digital object when you move a pencil

activity_3.title: Create a Simple MR Idea
steps: Think of one place in your house where Mixed Reality could be used.
Imagine a real and digital interaction in that place.
Draw your idea in your notebook.
Think about how the digital object will respond to real actions.
Explain your idea in simple words.
examples: Playing with a digital ball on a table
Learning science using a digital model reacting to your hand
Practicing sports with a virtual ball

extra_exploration.task: Observe situations where objects react to each other and think about how digital objects could follow the same rules in Mixed Reality.
examples: Door stopping when it hits a wall
Bicycle stopping when brakes are applied

think_and_notice: Which objects did you use in your activity?
How did the objects react to each other?
How could digital objects behave the same way in Mixed Reality?
activities.discussion_instruction: Discuss your ideas with your parents or elders.

learning_outcomes.title: Understand interaction between objects
learning_outcomes.description: Students observe how physical objects respond to forces and contact.

learning_outcomes.title: Understand the concept of Mixed Reality
learning_outcomes.description: Students recognize how digital objects can interact with real-world objects.

learning_outcomes.title: Develop observation and reasoning skills
learning_outcomes.description: Students analyze real-world interactions and relate them to technology.

learning_outcomes.title: Connect MR technology with real-life applications
learning_outcomes.description: Students understand how Mixed Reality can simulate real-world behavior.

bonus_activity: Look around your house and think of one game that could become more interesting using Mixed Reality.
Examples include hitting a digital cricket ball with a real bat, playing football with a virtual goalkeeper, or controlling a digital robot with your hand.
Think about how real actions could control digital objects.
